raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips AS T1 INNER JOIN zones AS T2 ON T1.pu_location_id = T2.location_id WHERE T2.borough = 'Manhattan' AND T1.pickup_datetime LIKE '8 PM' AND T1.pu_location_id IS NULL;

raw: SELECT zones.zone FROM trips JOIN zones ON trips.pu_location_id = zones.location_id WHERE pickup_datetime LIKE '08:%' GROUP BY trips.pu_location_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
sql: SELECT zones.zone FROM trips JOIN zones ON trips.pu_location_id = zones.location_id WHERE pickup_datetime LIKE '08:%' GROUP BY trips.pu_location_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

raw: SELECT AVG(passenger_count) FROM trips WHERE pu_location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE borough = 'Bronx') AND trip_distance > 1;
sql: SELECT AVG(passenger_count) FROM trips WHERE pu_location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE borough = 'Bronx') AND trip_distance > 1;

raw: SELECT borough FROM (SELECT borough, AVG(fare_amount) AS avg_fare FROM trips JOIN zones ON trips.pu_location_id = zones.location_id WHERE pickup_datetime LIKE '8/%/%' AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM pickup_datetime) = 5 GROUP BY borough ORDER BY avg_fare DESC LIMIT 1) AS subquery;
sql: SELECT borough FROM (SELECT borough, AVG(fare_amount) AS avg_fare FROM trips JOIN zones ON trips.pu_location_id = zones.location_id WHERE pickup_datetime LIKE '8/%/%' AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM pickup_datetime) = 5 GROUP BY borough ORDER BY avg_fare DESC LIMIT 1) AS subquery;
